document_api_meta.title: Search Products for Compliance Auditing
document_api_meta.env_desc:
Search live products and retrieve the product information needed by a compliance vendor to prepare a compliance testing report. The selection behavior is:
- If `product_ids` is non-empty, the operation retrieves those known products. This branch takes precedence; seller, product-title, category, and brand filters and pagination are not used to select products.
- Otherwise, the operation performs a shop search and requires `seller_id`, `seller_name`, or both. When both shop identifiers are provided, their matching sellers are combined. You can further filter this search by product title, category IDs, and brand IDs and paginate the results.

request_header_param.name: x-tts-access-token
request_header_param.desc:
Depends on the auth type of the API. 
1. The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.
2. The creator access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 1. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a362dccb8030ea6f98c) to get creator access_token.
3. The partner access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 3. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3978f4c20311b8b555) to get partner access_token.

request_query_param.name: shop_cipher
request_query_param.desc:
Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response. 
Get by API [Get Authorization Shop](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9?external_id=6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9)

request_query_param.name: category_asset_cipher
request_query_param.desc:
Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return The partner identifier used in API requests. 
Retrieve this value by using the [Get Authorized Category Assets API](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/666012dd609d4402cc3be995).

request_query_param.name: app_key
request_query_param.desc: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

request_query_param.name: sign
request_query_param.desc: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

request_query_param.name: timestamp
request_query_param.desc: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

request_query_param.name: page_token
request_query_param.desc: The opaque token used to retrieve the next page. Omit this parameter or pass an empty string for the first page. For subsequent pages, pass the `next_page_token` returned by the previous response.

request_query_param.name: page_size
request_query_param.desc:
The number of results to be returned per page. 
Valid range: [1-50]

request_body_param.name: product_title
request_body_param.desc:
The product title. 
Title length:
- DE, ES, FR, IE, IT, JP, UK, US: [1, 255] 
- BR, MX: [1, 300] 
- Other regions: [25, 255]

request_body_param.name: product_ids
request_body_param.desc: The product ID generated by TikTok Shop. Max is 20

request_body_param.name: category_ids
request_body_param.desc: Filter shop-search results by TikTok Shop category IDs.

request_body_param.name: brand_ids
request_body_param.desc: Filter shop-search results by TikTok Shop brand IDs.

request_body_param.name: seller_name
request_body_param.desc: The name of the shop which product belongs to.

response_param.name: code
response_param.desc: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

response_param.name: message
response_param.desc: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.

response_param.name: request_id
response_param.desc: Request log

response_param.name: data
response_param.desc: Specific return information

response_param.name: ^next_page_token
response_param.desc: The opaque token returned for a subsequent page. When this value is non-empty, pass it in the next request's `page_token`.

response_param.name: ^total_count
response_param.desc: The total number of products selected by the active mode. For direct product-ID lookup, this is the number of product IDs used for the lookup. For shop search, this is the total number of products matching the seller, product-title, category, and brand filters.

response_param.name: ^products
response_param.desc: Product information

response_param.name: ^^id
response_param.desc: The product ID generated by TikTok Shop.

response_param.name: ^^title
response_param.desc:
The product title. 
Title length:
- DE, ES, FR, IE, IT, JP, UK, US: [1, 255] 
- BR, MX: [1, 300] 
- Other regions: [25, 255]

response_param.name: ^^country
response_param.desc:
The regions where the product is sold.
Possible values:
- BR: Brazil
- DE: Germany
- ES: Spain
- FR: France
- GB: United Kingdom
- ID: Indonesia
- IE: Ireland
- IT: Italy
- JP: Japan
- MX: Mexico
- MY: Malaysia
- PH: Philippines
- SG: Singapore
- TH: Thailand
- US: United States
- VN: Vietnam

A flag to indicate if the category is a leaf category. 

Note: You can only create or edit products that belong to a leaf category.
